counting_method: Derived from recorded test-suite executions and fixed solver loop shapes, not measured simulator integrations.
derivation: Every synthetic solve checks10 candidate batches and1 mean. Legacy suite:4 horizon5 solves plus1 horizon3 and1 horizon2. New suite:4 solves for each of6 constant-mode tests (4 horizon2 and2 horizon3 modes), plus2 horizon5 native/infeasible solves.
scope: Setup test_lewm16 ran once. test_lewm17_campaign ran once individually and once within the17-test combined gate. Optimizer and bootstrap tests use synthetic arithmetic only. Mock recorder events are not real physics integrations.
allocation: Shared development verification, separate from admitted real episodes and per-optimizer resource allowances.
